comment: Past sessions (SDK 0.14.3): a signed-in app user's earlier sessions with an agent, like the dashboard's Execution History, and each one's transcript. Per user (the identity the app set with identify()) per agent (a web-call twin shares its primary's), only from a device bound to that user, never anyone else's. WIRE — two public routes, authenticated exactly like /api/embed/memory/list: POST /api/embed/sessions/list {publishableKey, installId, identity, cursor?, limit? (1–50, default 20)} → {sessions:[{id, startedAt, endedAt, durationSeconds, channel, direction, status, turns, preview}], next: string|null}, newest first; POST /api/embed/sessions/transcript {publishableKey, installId, identity, id} → {id, startedAt, endedAt, durationSeconds, channel, direction, status, turns:[{role, text, at}]}. `id` is the session's execution id (the id the session frame carries and Execution History shows); times are ISO-8601 UTC; channel is chat | voice | call; direction is inbound | outbound | null; status is the outcome in plain words (completed, missed, failed, …; pass through any other word); preview is the first customer line, at most 120 characters; role is user | assistant on the wire, customer | agent in the SDKs. The session that is open right now is never in the list. Refusals: {error, code} with code identity_required (400, no signed-in user), device_limit (403, this device is not bound to the user), not_found (404, unknown or not this user's — another user's session is a 404, never a 403), rate_limited (429), unavailable (503); the SDKs keep the code as the state's error word. SDK STATE (PUBLIC-STATE.md §1): chat.pastSessions {sessions, loading, hasMore, error}, empty until refreshPastSessions(); loadMorePastSessions() appends the next page; sessionTranscript(id) answers one transcript; an identity change clears the state (DESIGN.md "Who a chat belongs to"). Sections: `pages` (a list response → the items the SDK keeps; an item without an id or a readable startedAt is skipped; endedAt/durationSeconds unreadable → null; a channel other than voice/call is chat; a direction other than inbound/outbound is null; turns not a whole number ≥ 0 → 0; preview not a string → ""), `append` (pages in order → the state after each), `transcripts` (a transcript response → its turns; a turn without a user/assistant role, a string text or a readable at is skipped), `refusals` (status + body → the error word).
